sentence_stem: I bought two new shirts because
full_sentence: I bought two new shirts because I needed them for school.
acceptable_variants: I wanted to look nice at the party.
my old ones were too small.

options.text: and my brother has three bikes.
options.why_wrong: 'And' adds more information, but 'because' needs a reason for buying the shirts.

options.text: the shop is near my house.
options.why_wrong: This describes where the shop is, not why the shirts were bought.

options.text: I will buy more next week.
options.why_wrong: This is a future plan, not a reason for the action in the first part of the sentence.

explanation: After 'because', we need a clause that gives the reason for the first part. Turkish speakers may expect the reason to come first, so it helps to practise putting the reason after 'because' in English.
translation: İki yeni gömlek aldım çünkü onlara okul için ihtiyacım vardı.
